The '''Arcan IV Spaceport''' was a large [[Spaceport/Legends|starport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Arcan IV]], making the planet the [[Cronese Mandate/Legends|Cronese Mandate's]] principal spaceport.<ref name="Xim Week">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-the-history-of-xim-and-the-tion-cluster|text=Essential Atlas Extra: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster|int=Xim Week: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster}}</ref>

==History==
[[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] landed the ''[[Cobra]]'' in this spaceport during a mission to infiltrate [[Lemo and Sanda's gang]] to discover further information about [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo's]] current location after his capture by [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]]. After being found out by the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] gang, Calrissian and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] fled back to the spaceport and their ship in [[Landspeeder/Legends|hover cars]].<ref name="SW79">[[Star Wars (1977) 79|''Star Wars'' (1977) 79]]</ref>
